REPLACE:patriarchate_law = {
	law_category = religious
	law_religion_group = {
		orthodox
		strigolniki
		miaphysite
	} 

	potential = {
		OR = {
			religion = religion:orthodox
			religion = religion:strigolniki
			religion = religion:miaphysite
		}
		NOT = { has_policy = separate_clergy_from_state_policy }
	}
	separated_patriarchate_policy = {
        potential = { NOT = { tag = BYZ } }
		country_modifier = {
			join_autocephalous_patriarchate_cost_modifier = 0.2
			create_autocephalous_patriarchate_cost_modifier = 0.2
			third_rome_cost_modifier = 0.2
			clergy_estate_max_tax = 0.5
		}
		estate_preferences = {
			clergy_estate

		years = 2
	}
	state_patriarchate_policy = {
		country_modifier = {
			monthly_religious_influence = 0.1
		}
		estate_preferences = {
			nobles_estate
		}
		years = 2
	}
	combined_patriarchate_policy = {
		country_modifier = {
			monthly_religious_influence = 0.15
			join_autocephalous_patriarchate_cost_modifier = -0.2
			create_autocephalous_patriarchate_cost_modifier = -0.2
			third_rome_cost_modifier = -0.2
			global_clergy_estate_power = 0.5
		}
		estate_preferences = {
			crown_estate
		}
		years = 2
	}
	most_holy_synod_policy = {
		unique = yes
		potential = {
			culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:russian_group }
			country_rank_level > 2
		}
		country_modifier = {
			monthly_religious_influence = 0.2
			third_rome_cost_modifier = -0.33
			global_clergy_estate_power = -0.1
		}
		estate_preferences = {
			nobles_estate
			crown_estate
		}
		years = 2
	}
    oe_byz_ecumenical_patriarch_policy = {
        unique = yes
        potential = { tag = BYZ }

            monthly_religious_influence = 0.1
